title: Review and improve
desc: Read your journal every week and improve your plan one change at a time

cards.title: Fix it all at once?
cards.situation: After a bad week you want to change your entry, your stop and your markets, all at once. What’s the problem?

options.text: None: more changes fix things faster
options.feedback: One bad week can be bad luck. Changing three rules at once also hides what worked.

options.text: You won’t know which change helped
options.feedback: Change one thing, then measure it. That’s how a plan gets better.

options.text: You should only change your markets
options.feedback: Your markets may not be the problem. One bad week can be luck: change one thing and measure it.

cards.work: 3 changes at once. Results get better or worse: which change did it? You can’t tell.

cards.title: The weekly review
cards.text: Once a week you read your **[[trading-journal|journal]]** and ask the same four questions.

items.title: Wins, losses, average win vs loss

blocks.tip: Judge the process, not one week’s profit.

cards.title: What the journal shows
cards.text: Last 20 trades, split by one question: did you follow your plan?

items.label: The 5 trades that broke a rule lost $780

rows.note: Bought far above the setup: worse price, stop far away.
The biggest leak: two 1% losses grew to $400.
One rushed trade the checklist would have stopped.

cards.foot: The plan made money. The exceptions lost it. The fix isn’t a new rule: it’s following the old ones.

cards.title: Change one rule at a time
cards.text: Change **one** thing. Keep the rest the same. Judge it on **20 trades or more**, not on the next three.

blocks.tip: A few trades prove nothing. Luck evens out only over many.

cards.title: One change
cards.q: Your review shows most losses came from trades open during earnings. Which change fits best?

options.text: Change your entry, stop and markets
options.feedback: The journal points at one problem: earnings. One rule fixes it, and you can measure it.

options.text: Add one rule: no new trades in the week before earnings
options.feedback: One rule aimed at the one problem the journal found. Test it, then judge it over 20 trades or more.

options.text: Double your size to win it back
options.feedback: Bigger size makes the earnings losses bigger. Fix the one problem the journal shows.
Without a journal you can’t see what’s going wrong. Keep it, and fix the one problem it shows.

cards.title: Too soon to tell
cards.q: You changed one rule last week. After 3 trades, 2 lost. What should you do?

options.feedback: 2 losses in 3 can happen to any good rule. Judge it after 20 trades or more.

options.text: Keep testing: 3 trades is too few
options.feedback: 3 trades is mostly luck. Keep the rule and judge it after 20 trades or more.
More changes at once hide what works. Keep testing the one change first.

options.text: Risk more to test it faster
options.feedback: More risk makes the test cost more, not go faster. Same size, 20 trades or more.

cards.headline: Your plan is complete.
lines: Judge the process, not one week’s profit.
Change one rule at a time. Test it on 20+ trades.
